items.source: Support classes for the integration of FreeMarker as Spring web view technology.
items.translation: 支持将 FreeMarker 集成作为 Spring Web 视图技术的类。

items.source: Support classes for setting up FreeMarker within a Spring application context.
items.translation: 支持在 Spring 应用程序上下文中设置 FreeMarker 的辅助类。

items.source: Factory bean that creates a FreeMarker Configuration and provides it as a bean reference.
items.translation: 创建 FreeMarkerConfiguration 并将其作为 bean 引用提供的工厂 bean。

items.source:
Configures FreeMarker for web usage via the "configLocation",
"freemarkerSettings", or "templateLoaderPath" properties.
items.translation: 通过"configLocation"、"freemarkerSettings"或"templateLoaderPath"属性配置 FreeMarker 以用于 Web。

items.source:
Bean to configure FreeMarker for web usage, via the "configLocation",
"freemarkerSettings", or "templateLoaderPath" properties.
items.translation: 用于通过 "configLocation"、"freemarkerSettings" 或 "templateLoaderPath" 属性配置 FreeMarker 以用于 Web 的 Bean。
